fullPassage: Young children write with all their attention focused on each letter. Despite this, it's common for them to write some of the letters backwards. This is called "mirror writing," and it may be caused by the way our brains store images, known as "mirror generalization." When we remember images, we focus on shape rather than orientation. This is because early humans needed to be able to recognize a dangerous predator, such as a tiger, from any angle. Therefore, whether we're looking at a tiger directly or from the side, we still immediately know it's a tiger. It is believed that mirror generalization, combined with a child's weak understanding of right and left, is what causes the occasional backward letter.

questions.passage: Young children write with all their attention focused on each letter. Despite this, it's common for them to write some of the letters backwards. This is called "mirror writing," and it may be caused by the way our brains store images, known as "mirror generalization." When we remember images, we focus on shape rather than orientation. This is because early humans needed to be able to recognize a dangerous predator, such as a tiger, from any angle. Therefore, whether we're looking at a tiger directly or from the side, we still immediately know it's a tiger. It is believed that mirror generalization, combined with a child's weak understanding of right and left, is what causes the occasional backward letter.

[조건] (1) focus, on, orientation, rather, shape, than, we를 모두 사용

det.korean: we focus on shape rather than orientation = 우리는 방향보다 형태에 집중한다
det.analysis:
주어 we(우리는)로 시작해요. '집중하다'는 focus on이라 we focus on으로 이어요.

'방향보다 형태에'는 'A rather than B(B보다 A)' 구조예요. '형태에 집중'이 핵심이므로 shape를 앞에, '방향보다'의 orientation을 rather than 뒤에 둬요: shape rather than orientation.

순서: we(주어) + focus on(집중하다) + shape(형태) + rather than orientation(방향보다).
det.tip: A rather than B = B보다 A. 형태에 집중이 핵심 → shape rather than orientation
